description: Returns a list of Upload Requirements for the Project. When multiple naming standards are enabled, the default rule also carries routing_field and routing_field_derived.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Language for the response to be translated into

200.description: Returns Upload Requirements for the Project

routing_field.description: Field the project routes upload requirements on. Default rule only; present only when multiple naming standards are enabled.

routing_field_derived.description: True when routing_field was inferred from the conditional rules rather than stored on the default rule.

name.description: Rule name. Null on the default rule and on rules created before names existed. Present only when multiple naming standards are enabled.

name_is_system_generated.description: True when the name was assigned by the system rather than chosen by an admin. Present only when multiple naming standards are enabled.

400.description:
Bad Request

Possible reason codes:
- MISSING_REQUIRED_PROPERTY
- INVALID_PROPERTY
